title: Porismata: not favor of princes, wife and children, or goods of body and mind taken together
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): (12) Nor in these goods belonging toward body plus mind taken together. (11) Just as ye highest good stands as contained neither in goods belonging toward ye body nor in external goods, so neither in goods belonging toward ye mind alone. || they do not eternalize. they often turn to evil; they stand as lost; (10) Nor stands as it in wife plus children — they stand as outside us; || (8) Nor stands as it ye favor belonging toward kings, princes, plus others — more by flattery than by desert.
pass_b_english: (8) Nor is it the favor of kings, princes, and others — more by flattery than by desert.
(10) Nor is it in wife and children — they are outside us; they are lost; they often turn to evil; they do not eternalize.
(11) Just as the highest good is contained neither in goods of the body nor in external goods, so neither in goods of the mind alone. (12) Nor in these goods of body and mind taken together.
source_text: 8. Neque est favor regum, principum, aliorum — affentatione plus quam merito. 10. Neque est in uxore & liberis — sunt extra nos; amittuntur; vertuntur saepe in malum; non aeternant. 11. Sicut summum bonum neque corporis neque externis bonis continetur, ita neque animi bonis solis. 12. Neque in his bonis corporis & animi simul sumtis.
